caseNameFull: Cutting v. Higley, Administrator of Veterans Affairs
attorneys: Claude L. Dawson for petitioners. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Doub, Melvin Richter and Lester S. Jayson for respondents.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to file brief of Queens County American Legion, Department of New York, as amicus curiae, is denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit denied.
